decisions.reason: The original paragraph stipulated supplied unitarity, but left exp(-itH/hbar) undefined for a general linear operator on an arbitrary domain. Linearity alone cannot justify that expression: on C, H=i E_* I with E_*>0 joules has exponential e^(t E_*/hbar) I, which is not unitary for t nonzero. The repair explicitly requires a dense-domain self-adjoint autonomous Hamiltonian and defines the exponential by the published Countable-Choice spectral calculus; unbounded self-adjoint Hamiltonians are allowed.
